title: Adaptive rollforward criteria and initiative initiation checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a bounded playbook (checklist + gating logic) for deciding whether reliability initiatives should be rolled forward, paused, or canceled at cycle boundaries. The playbook must be usable by PMs and engineering leads, map to our SLO/SLI windows and error-budget status, and include automated signals (dashboards/alerts) plus manual checkpoints for product impact decisions.
acceptance_criteria: A concise one-page initiation checklist published in Confluence
Automated gating rule definitions surfaced in the Initiative Tracker dashboard
Runbook entries for 'rollforward', 'pause', and 'cancel' with owner assignments and communication templates
Simulation of gating rules on 6 months of SLI data with summary of false positives/negatives
Sign-off from Reliability PM, Head of Engineering, and two feature-area PMs
decision_log: 2025-02-14: Decided to use a 7-day and 28-day SLI window pair for gating instead of single-window approach (reason: reduces noise at short windows while still capturing trends). - Aisha

2025-02-21: Chose conservative thresholds for rollforward threshold to avoid canceling initiatives mid-flight: rollforward allowed if 28-day error budget burn <= 20% AND leading indicator (7-day) trend slope is non-increasing. - Reliability Working Group
2025-02-25: Delegated automation of gating alerts to Observability infra (ENG-11890) and added manual approval step for high-customer-impact initiatives. - Liam
comments: 2025-02-13 Aisha: Draft checklist posted to Confluence (link below). Request reviews from Platform PMs and two feature PMs.
2025-02-18 Maya R. (Eng): Ran initial simulation; 3 of 52 past initiatives would have been auto-paused under proposed thresholds. Need to investigate customer-impact sensitivity.
2025-02-20 Jonas (Platform PM): Suggest add a manual override flag with required justification and 2 approvers for customer-facing features.
2025-02-24 Observability: Automation PR opened to create gating alerts (github.com/redwood/observability/pull/482). Will add an example alert channel to the initiative card.

2025-03-02 Liam: Incorporated feedback; checklist now includes a 'data sufficiency' gate (requires >= 7 days of steady telemetry) and explicit rollback plan template for the on-call lead. Ready for stakeholder sign-off.
